sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: P02 Health care in 2009, telemedicine bullet

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Remote examinations using sight, sound and tactile sensing are widely used.
reference.rationale: Audio/video telemedicine and remote-device demonstrations did not make the full visual-auditory-haptic package widespread in 2009. The 37% US adult telemedicine-use figure for 2021 establishes ordinary audio/video care, but not widespread remotely conveyed tactile examination.
